"""
Dashboard server with SAFE_MODE validation.

Serves HTML files only after validating that they contain
exclusively approved CSS classes. Any unknown class name
causes the request to be rejected.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

SAFE_MODE: bool = True

# Directory from which HTML files are served.
DASHBOARD_DIR: Path = Path(__file__).parent / "dashboard"

# Whitelist of CSS class names that are permitted in served HTML files.
APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES: frozenset[str] = frozenset(
    {
        # Layout
        "container",
        "row",
        "col",
        "header",
        "footer",
        "sidebar",
        "main",
        "section",
        # Components
        "card",
        "card-header",
        "card-body",
        "card-footer",
        "btn",
        "btn-primary",
        "btn-secondary",
        "btn-danger",
        "nav",
        "nav-item",
        "nav-link",
        "table",
        "table-striped",
        # Dashboard widgets
        "dashboard",
        "widget",
        "widget-title",
        "widget-content",
        "metric",
        "metric-label",
        "metric-value",
        "chart",
        # Utilities
        "text-center",
        "text-muted",
        "hidden",
        "active",
    }
)

# Matches the value of a class="..." or class='...' attribute.
_CLASS_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
    r"""class\s*=\s*(?P<quote>["'])(?P<value>.*?)(?P=quote)""",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def extract_css_classes(html: str) -> set[str]:
    """Return the set of CSS class names referenced in *html*."""
    classes: set[str] = set()
    for match in _CLASS_ATTR_RE.finditer(html):
        for cls in match.group("value").split():
            cls = cls.strip()
            if cls:
                classes.add(cls)
    return classes


def validate_html(html: str) -> tuple[bool, set[str]]:
    """
    Validate that *html* uses only approved CSS classes.

    Returns a tuple ``(is_valid, disallowed_classes)``.
    """
    used = extract_css_classes(html)
    disallowed = used - APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES
    return (not disallowed), disallowed


def validate_file(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, set[str]]:
    """Validate the HTML file at *path*."""
    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return validate_html(html)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP handler
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class DashboardHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _safe_resolve(self, url_path: str) -> Path | None:
        """Resolve *url_path* to a file inside DASHBOARD_DIR, or None."""
        rel = url_path.lstrip("/") or "index.html"
        candidate = (DASHBOARD_DIR / rel).resolve()
        try:
            candidate.relative_to(DASHBOARD_DIR.resolve())
        except ValueError:
            return None  # Path traversal attempt.
        return candidate

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (BaseHTTPRequestHandler API)
        path = self._safe_resolve(self.path)
        if path is None or not path.is_file():
            self.send_error(404, "File not found")
            return

        if path.suffix.lower() in {".html", ".htm"}:
            try:
                html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            except OSError as exc:
                self.send_error(500, f"Could not read file: {exc}")
                return

            if SAFE_MODE:
                ok, disallowed = validate_html(html)
                if not ok:
                    self.send_error(
                        403,
                        "Refused by SAFE_MODE: disallowed CSS classes "
                        + ", ".join(sorted(disallowed)),
                    )
                    return

            body = html.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
            return

        # Non-HTML assets are served as-is (no class validation needed).
        try:
            data = path.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            self.send_error(500, f"Could not read file: {exc}")
            return
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def run(host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8000) -> None:
    if SAFE_MODE:
        print(f"[SAFE_MODE] Serving {DASHBOARD_DIR} on http://{host}:{port}")
        print(
            f"[SAFE_MODE] {len(APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES)} approved CSS classes loaded."
        )
    server = HTTPServer((host, port), DashboardHandler)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nShutting down.")
        server.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()

"""
Dashboard server with SAFE_MODE validation.

Serves HTML files on http://localhost:6060 only after validating that
they contain exclusively approved CSS classes. Any unknown class name
causes the request to be rejected with HTTP 403.

If SAFE_MODE is False, the server refuses to start at all -- validation
is mandatory for this dashboard.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

SAFE_MODE: bool = True

HOST: str = "localhost"
PORT: int = 6060

# Directory from which HTML files are served.
DASHBOARD_DIR: Path = Path(__file__).parent / "dashboard"

# Whitelist of CSS class names that are permitted in served HTML files.
APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES: frozenset[str] = frozenset(
    {
        # Layout
        "container", "row", "col",
        "header", "footer", "sidebar", "main", "section",
        # Components
        "card", "card-header", "card-body", "card-footer",
        "btn", "btn-primary", "btn-secondary", "btn-danger",
        "nav", "nav-item", "nav-link",
        "table", "table-striped",
        # Dashboard widgets
        "dashboard", "widget", "widget-title", "widget-content",
        "metric", "metric-label", "metric-value", "chart",
        # Utilities
        "text-center", "text-muted", "hidden", "active",
    }
)

# Matches the value of a class="..." or class='...' attribute.
_CLASS_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
    r"""class\s*=\s*(?P<quote>["'])(?P<value>.*?)(?P=quote)""",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def extract_css_classes(html: str) -> set[str]:
    """Return the set of CSS class names referenced in *html*."""
    classes: set[str] = set()
    for match in _CLASS_ATTR_RE.finditer(html):
        for cls in match.group("value").split():
            cls = cls.strip()
            if cls:
                classes.add(cls)
    return classes


def validate_html(html: str) -> tuple[bool, set[str]]:
    """
    Validate that *html* uses only approved CSS classes.

    Returns a tuple ``(is_valid, disallowed_classes)``.
    """
    used = extract_css_classes(html)
    disallowed = used - APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES
    return (not disallowed), disallowed


def validate_file(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, set[str]]:
    """Validate the HTML file at *path*."""
    return validate_html(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP handler
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class DashboardHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "SafeDashboard/1.0"

    def _safe_resolve(self, url_path: str) -> Path | None:
        """Resolve *url_path* to a file inside DASHBOARD_DIR, or None."""
        # Strip query string if any.
        url_path = url_path.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
        rel = url_path.lstrip("/") or "index.html"
        try:
            candidate = (DASHBOARD_DIR / rel).resolve()
            candidate.relative_to(DASHBOARD_DIR.resolve())
        except (ValueError, OSError):
            return None  # Path traversal or bad path.
        return candidate

    def _send_text(self, status: int, message: str) -> None:
        body = message.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (BaseHTTPRequestHandler API)
        # SAFE_MODE is required; refuse to serve anything if it's off.
        if not SAFE_MODE:
            self._send_text(503, "Service unavailable: SAFE_MODE is disabled.")
            return

        path = self._safe_resolve(self.path)
        if path is None or not path.is_file():
            self._send_text(404, "File not found.")
            return

        suffix = path.suffix.lower()

        if suffix in {".html", ".htm"}:
            try:
                html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            except OSError as exc:
                self._send_text(500, f"Could not read file: {exc}")
                return

            ok, disallowed = validate_html(html)
            if not ok:
                self.log_error(
                    "SAFE_MODE rejected %s: disallowed classes %s",
                    path.name,
                    sorted(disallowed),
                )
                self._send_text(
                    403,
                    "Refused by SAFE_MODE: disallowed CSS classes: "
                    + ", ".join(sorted(disallowed)),
                )
                return

            body = html.encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.send_header("X-Safe-Mode", "validated")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
            return

        # Non-HTML assets (css, js, images) are served as-is.
        try:
            data = path.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            self._send_text(500, f"Could not read file: {exc}")
            return

        content_type = {
            ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
            ".js": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8",
            ".json": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
            ".png": "image/png",
            ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
            ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
            ".gif": "image/gif",
            ".ico": "image/x-icon",
            ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
        }.get(suffix, "application/octet-stream")

        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def run(host: str = HOST, port: int = PORT) -> None:
    if not SAFE_MODE:
        print("Refusing to start: SAFE_MODE must be True.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    if not DASHBOARD_DIR.is_dir():
        print(
            f"Refusing to start: dashboard directory {DASHBOARD_DIR} "
            "does not exist.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"[SAFE_MODE] Serving {DASHBOARD_DIR} on http://{host}:{port}")
    print(
        f"[SAFE_MODE] {len(APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES)} approved CSS classes loaded."
    )

    server = HTTPServer((host, port), DashboardHandler)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nShutting down.")
    finally:
        server.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
